messages:
sarah-sales: FYI CrescentBank on the POC just sent a combined ask — SOC2 artifacts, a signed pen-test attestation, and they'd like split billing (Hosted for dev, Dedicated for prod). Can ops/security/legal confirm what we can hand over for a short POC and pricing implications?

alex-eng: For a POC we can share the SOC2 Type II summary (redacted), system architecture diagram, and a short list of controls we map to. Full reports require LOA/dataroom access. For the Dedicated side we can provision a short-term reserved pool for the POC (48-72h bursts) if sales signs the addendum.

mike-security: @sarah-sales we can sign a pen-test attestation letter. Need CrescentBank to confirm scope (external-only vs internal scans) and provide the exact bastion/public IPs for us to whitelist. We also need the pen-test signatory name + org for our template.

tara-ops: Split billing is doable as two line items: Hosted usage (per-token) + Dedicated reserved capacity (monthly pro-rated). For short POCs we usually do a weekly reserved rate + usage overage. I can run a quick quote once you give me requested QPS and expected token volume.

jen-legal: We have a standard pen-test letter template. We do not hand over raw scan data or attack findings by default — we provide attestation that a pen test occurred and a summary of remediation status. If customer needs findings we require an NDA + approved redaction plan. Link to template: https://redwood.internal/legal/pen-test-template (internal).

alex-eng: Also note: if they request KMS proofs or logs from Dedicated nodes, that's an escalation — we can export certain operational artifacts but that needs a support SLA + MSA clause.

sarah-sales: Helpful. I'm going to ask them to confirm scope and provide the name for the pen-test signatory, plus send expected QPS and token counts. Can someone paste the minimal artifact list we can commit to for initial delivery?

mike-security: Minimal deliverables for POC: 1) SOC2 Type II summary (redacted), 2) network/system diagram, 3) signed pen-test attestation (scope-defined), 4) list of encryption-in-transit and at-rest controls, 5) high-level remediation status.

tara-ops: From ops for billing/POC provisioning: 1) expected concurrent requests/QPS, 2) target latency SLA for POC, 3) expected peak token/day, 4) whether dev traffic stays on Hosted region eu-west or needs a Dedicated region. Example snippet to request from customer:

```
Please provide:
- Pen-test scope: external/internal/both
- Signatory name + title + email
- Expected QPS and peak tokens/day for POC
- IPs or CIDR ranges for allowed scanning (if external)
- Any special data residency requirements
```

jen-legal: Also add: which legal entity will sign the LOA/NDA and whether procurement needs vendor form filled. If they push for raw findings, flag to legal.

evidence-bot: Created evidence ticket EVD-4537 to bundle SOC2 summary + diagrams + attestation once inputs received. Assign owner: @mike-security.

sarah-sales: Great — I'll message the customer now with those asks and loop ops/sec/legal on reply. ETA: I expect their answers by EOD tomorrow.

alex-eng: lgtm, will standby for the scope and then I'll schedule the short reserved pool.

mike-security: thx. once they confirm, i'll prep the pen-test letter for sig. :thumbsup:

tara-ops: ping salesops@redwood.com for the quote. I can turn around a provisional price in <24h once QPS + tokens are provided.

sarah-sales: thanks team :pray:
